title: Off-Policy Value Sets with Rewards Missing Not at Random in Finite-Horizon Decision Processes
banked_reason: The proposed coefficient-complete, relatively open strict-containment certificate remains an unresolved obligation; the proved supporting results do not supply the advertised dynamic novelty.
gap_reasons: The proposed theorem-level contribution—a coefficient-complete, relatively open strict-containment certificate with a rational witness and equality locus—has been replaced by an expressly unresolved obligation; the proved compactness, face identity, static reduction, CAD specialization, and fiber-inversion coverage do not supply that advertised dynamic novelty.

The compact-face criterion reduces strict containment to emptiness of a simultaneous stage-face system, while the signed-minor calculation only certifies a local objective slope. It does not show that locally forced opposite boundary choices are incompatible with one globally coupled complete-history law.
proof_attempt_summary: Four substantive D0 solve rounds corrected the behavior-factorization model, proved the supporting compactness/CAD/static-reduction/coverage results, and produced an exact fixed-(p,mu) policy-slice phase diagram with rational interval [229/140,26/15] and 1/6 endpoint gaps. The attempt did not prove strict containment on a relatively open region of the full compatible (p,mu,pi) parameter space; doing so still requires a concrete rational witness plus the cross-stage elimination and sign certificate, so the field-tier headline remains open.
tldr: Finite-horizon off-policy value with MNAR discrete rewards is the image of a compact semialgebraic full-history fiber. The sole headline target remains an exact \(H=2\), binary-action, three-reward generic strict-containment result: a coefficient-complete observed table, rational completion parameterization, observable elimination minors with a nonempty relatively open sign region, an exact witness, and the exceptional equality variety. Compact attainment, common-face geometry, and fixed-law exact elimination remain supporting results. The one-stage Chen sanity proposition is now discharged by an explicit cellwise bijection, exact value-image calculation, endpoint formula, and a locally proved full-column-rank singleton lemma.
gap: Static weak-shadow linear programs do not characterize dynamic compatibility when latent reward completion changes later oracle-policy occupancy. Iyengar's rectangular robust dynamic program assumes the product structure that an MNAR observed-data inverse fiber need not possess.
fill: The project makes that exact two-stage generic strict-containment dossier the sole headline obligation. Compact attainment, common-face geometry, the source-label-pinned one-stage Chen sanity reduction, and fixed-law quantifier elimination serve only as supporting results.
